blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Makabayan bloc lawmakers have sought a House inquiry into the “alarming escalation” of repression against students and youth leaders who are just protesting against anomalies in government. “We are condemning the escalating instances of repression, and we want the House of Representatives to immediately investigate human rights violations like these,” Kabataan Rep.
